description: Reviewable excerpts used to derive courseVector expected data. Paths are normative locators, not runtime dependencies; hashes cover the exact checked-in excerpt text.

sources.excerpt: P3 course CPU vectors use PC=0x00003000, zeroed GPR/DM reset state, and the course IM/DM address ranges frozen by COURSE-P3-RESET-001 and COURSE-P3-ADDR-001/002.
处理器为 32 位单周期处理器，不考虑延迟槽，应支持的指令集为： add, sub, ori, lw, sw, beq, lui, jal, jr, nop。add, sub 按无符号加减法处理（不考虑溢出）。
处理器应支持 add, sub, ori, lw, sw, beq, lui, jal, jr, nop。对于 b 类和 j 类指令，流水线设计必须支持延迟槽，因此设计需要注意使用 PC@D + 8 或 PC@I + 4。
P6 adds lb, lh, sb, sh and mult, multu, div, divu, mfhi, mflo, mthi, mtlo. Byte enables map address lanes 00/01/10/11 to 0001/0010/0100/1000; lb/lh sign-extend the selected byte/halfword.

CP0 implements SR(12), Cause(13), EPC(14). SR fields are IM[15:10], EXL[1], IE[0]; Cause fields are BD[31], IP[15:10], ExcCode[6:2]. CP0 reset and unimplemented bits are zero, requests set EXL, and eret clears EXL.

A precise exception commits all older instructions and no victim/younger architectural effects. EPC is victim PC, or victim PC-4 with BD set for a delay-slot victim. P7 ExcCode includes Int=0, AdEL=4, AdES=5, Syscall=8, RI=10, Ov=12.

Official Timer state machine: IDLE observes CTRL.enable, LOAD copies PRESET to COUNT, CNT decrements until COUNT<=1 then enters INT and raises the internal IRQ latch, and INT returns to IDLE according to CTRL mode. A write has priority over the state transition for that edge.

The external interrupt stays asserted until the system responds. Any enabled store to the word-aligned response address 0x00007f20 acknowledges it; Timer0, Timer1, and the external generator connect to HWInt[0], HWInt[1], and HWInt[2].
